note: Synthetic example. Names and node IDs are illustrative. Times only; no date was given.

messages.author: Marja Niemi
messages.text: Ilmari, RBS-310 keeps dropping off and coming back, roughly every 40 minutes since noon. DC low alarms in between. You are the closest, can you go?

messages.author: Ilmari Karjalainen
messages.text: I'm 30 minutes away. Is it the same cabinet type as RBS-301?

messages.author: Ilmari Karjalainen
messages.text: On site. Rectifier module 2 is warm and its fan is loud. DC voltage swings between 46 and 53 volts.

messages.author: Risto Peltola
messages.text: Sounds like module 2 is failing. Swap it, there are spares in the depot box. Pirkko was out at that cabinet in the spring, I think, so she may have noted something.

messages.author: Ilmari Karjalainen
messages.text: Swapped module 2. Voltage is steady at 53.4 volts now, no resets for 25 minutes.

messages.author: Marja Niemi
messages.text: Confirmed from the NOC side, the site has been stable since 15:38.

messages.author: Risto Peltola
messages.text: Good. Keep the old module for inspection please.

messages.author: Ilmari Karjalainen
messages.text: Will do. Did you hear the canteen is switching to the new lunch menu tomorrow?
